preconditions.description: Attacker must hold at least 1 QAP token to perform a transfer

exploit_hint: The vulnerability is that _maxTxAmount and numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity are incorrectly initialized with values that exceed the total supply. This makes the transaction limit check ineffective and prevents automatic liquidity addition. To demonstrate the issue, simply transfer any amount greater than the actual total supply (which should be impossible but the check will pass due to incorrect initialization). The exploit shows that the transaction limit is not properly enforced.
